origin_rule: the forecast origin in which the largest share of municipalities exceeded the 75th percentile of their own history -- the record season -- rather than a fixed year, so that the figure follows the data instead of freezing on one origin
alert_rule: alert when the predicted probability of exceeding the unit's own 75th percentile is at least one half; declared, not fitted to the season drawn
panels: the alert at the declared threshold
outcome of the alert: hit, false alarm, missed, correct silence
false alarms against the size of the alert list
